0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies, and Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot, out) while Kyle Filipowski (back) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (ankle, out), and Micah Peavy (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split the 2025-26 series 2-2, with Utah winning the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
